title: biscutella varia subsp. kerneri
intro: Biscutella varia subsp. kerneri, commonly known as Kerner's biscuitroot, is a rare plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Biscutella varia subsp. kerneri are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-arthritic, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancerous effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
